# Terms of Service

**Draft pending legal review. Not yet in force.**

Last updated: 28 August 2026

## In short

- You may use Salony to run your salon. The app is licensed to you, not sold.
- Your salon's records belong to you and stay on your devices. Keeping a
  backup is your responsibility, because nobody else holds a copy and nobody
  else can restore one.
- The app is free. Sync over the internet is optional, uses a relay the
  developer operates, and requires signing in with Apple or Google. A
  subscription per store may apply; if one lapses, the app keeps working
  and only internet sync stops.
- The app is provided as it is, without a warranty, and the developer's
  liability is limited to what the law allows.

The sections below are the agreement itself.

## 1. Agreement

Salony is built and published by one person rather than a company. These
terms call them **the developer**, and the agreement is between you and that
person, covering the Salony application and the optional relay service. By
installing or using Salony you accept them. If you do not accept them, do
not use the app.

If you use Salony on behalf of a business, you confirm that you may accept
these terms for that business.

## 2. Licence

The developer grants you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable,
revocable licence to install and use Salony on devices you own or control,
for running your own salon business.

You may not: resell, rent or sublicense the app; remove or obscure notices

## 3. Your data and your backups

Your salon's records are yours. They are written to your devices and are not
transmitted to the developer.

Because there is no cloud copy, **you are responsible for keeping backups**.
If a device is lost, damaged, wiped or stolen, and it holds the only copy of
your records, those records are gone. Salony provides an encrypted export for
exactly this reason; use it, and keep the archive somewhere other than the
device it came from. The passphrase protecting an export cannot be recovered
by anyone, including the developer.

You are also responsible for what you collect about your own customers and
staff, for telling them what you collect where the law requires it, and for
handling their requests about that data.

## 4. Acceptable use

You agree not to use Salony or the relay service to store or transmit
unlawful content, to attack, overload or probe the relay or other users'
devices, to circumvent licence checks, or to gain access to devices you are
not authorised to reach.

## 5. Optional paid services

Salony is distributed as a free application. There is nothing to buy inside
it.

Sync over the internet uses a relay service operated by the developer. Using
that relay requires an account, created by signing in with Apple or Google.
Local use, pairing, and sync on the same network do not.

The relay may require a subscription per store. Where it does:

- The price, billing period and renewal terms are those shown at the point of
  purchase.
- A subscription can be cancelled at any time; cancellation takes effect at
  the end of the paid period.
- When a subscription lapses, devices stop connecting to the relay. **The app
  continues to work**: local operation and sync between devices on the same
  network are not affected.
- Payments made through the App Store or Google Play are handled by Apple or
  Google under their terms, including their refund policies.

Deleting the account stops licence renewal for internet sync. It does not
delete your salon data, which remains on your devices. To delete the
account, write to ntqui1502@gmail.com. Signing out on a device is not the
same as deleting the account.

## 6. Availability

The relay service is provided on a best-effort basis. It may be interrupted
for maintenance, or discontinued with reasonable notice. Because the app is
built to work offline, an interruption of the relay does not stop you running
your salon; it stops devices reaching each other over the internet.

## 7. App stores

If you obtained Salony from the App Store or Google Play, that store's terms
also apply to your download and any purchase. Those stores are not parties to
this agreement and are not responsible for the app.
